## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
*Example: As an agent developer, I find it cumbersome to...*

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. Include architectural considerations, API endpoint ideas, or UI designs if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Security & Architectural Impact
Does this feature impact financial authority, spending limits, TEE execution, or wallet security boundaries?
- [ ] No impact on financial enforcement
- [ ] Modifies policy engine or boundary checks (requires security review)

## Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or mockups here.
